lines.t: Seek out the physician…
Seek out the physician…
Seek out the Healer to turn the tide.
But the proud of heart, they walk their own way,
Calling themselves whole while they go astray.
Sitting in shadows of their own design,
Blinded by comfort, they claim they shine.
Seek out the Healer to turn the tide.
But the proud of heart, they walk their own way,
Calling themselves whole while they go astray.
Sitting in shadows of their own design,
Blinded by comfort, they claim they shine.
Seek out the Physician, don’t be afraid,
Lay down your pride, let the healing be made.
Those who rest in darkness can’t see the light,
Only the humble will be made right.
They rest on laurels, built high and tall,
But every fortress of flesh must fall.
Trusting in thoughts they’ve made their throne,
Forgetting the grace they could’ve known.
The light is near, but they turn away,
Keeping truth at arms’ length day by day.
Seek out the Physician, don’t be afraid,
Lay down your pride, let the healing be made.
Those who rest in darkness can’t see the light,
Only the humble will be made right.
Oh, when you know you’re sick, you find repair,
Mercy awaits for those who care.
But those self-made in their own esteem,
Miss out the love beyond the dream.
Seek out the Physician, don’t be afraid,
Lay down your pride, let the healing be made.
Those who rest in darkness can’t see the light,
Only the humble will be made right.
Only those who know they’re sick will see,
The door wide open to liberty.
Come out of the dark, let your eyes be new,
The Healer waits, He’s calling you.
Come out of the dark, let your eyes be new,
The Healer waits, He’s calling you.
